title: KartArchetype and Racer
description: Base handling constants, the three archetype multipliers, the eight racers, and the shared kart bodies. Bodies and skins are cosmetic only; the racer owns the class.

boostMultiplier.description: Drift mini-turbo. Mario Kart Wii's mini-turbo is +30%; the +20% row is its standstill mini-turbo.

padMultiplier.description: Mario Kart Wii dash panel: +40% for 60 frames.

slipstreamSeconds.description: Seconds in a wake before the boost fires

gripRoad.description: Lateral velocity damping per second. Mario Kart does NOT reduce grip off-road; the off-road penalty is the speed cap in surfaceSpeed. Only slippery surfaces (ice) cut grip. See docs/sops/kart-controller.md Approach.

gripOffroad.description: Dirt. Equal to gripRoad on purpose (MK8DX BrakeRt only caps speed off-road).

gripMud.description: Equal to gripRoad on purpose; mud is punished by surfaceSpeed, not by grip.

gripIce.description: The one surface that really slides (MK8DX SlipRt applies to ice and sand).

surfaceSpeed.description: Top-speed cap per surface, as a fraction of the kart's on-road top speed. This is how Mario Kart models off-road: a hard speed cap, not drag and not grip. MK8DX datamined BrakeRt for dirt terrain has three tiers, 0.7 light / 0.5 medium / 0.3 heavy (deep sand). We map dirt to the light tier and mud to the medium tier; 0.3 stays free for a future deep-mud surface. Ice takes the slippery-terrain value (~0.9) and pays the rest in grip. The cap is ignored while a boost is live and while airborne (both are real MK rules, and they are what makes the hop-over-off-road line worth learning).

mud.description: MK8DX's medium off-road tier is 0.5; softened to 0.6 by design decision 8 Sept 2026.

boostIgnoresSurfaceCap.description: MK Wii: a dash-panel boost carries off-road immunity. We apply it to every boost source for one readable rule.

airborneIgnoresSurfaceCap.description: No ground contact, no surface cap. This is what makes hopping over a mud patch work.

gravity.description: m/s². No Mario Kart datamine exists for this; tuned so hopSeconds lands.

hopVelocity.description: m/s. gravity × hopSeconds / 2 so a flat hop lasts exactly hopSeconds.

overSpeedDecel.description: m/s². How fast speed falls back to the cap when a boost ends or a surface cap bites.

reverseFraction.description: Reverse top speed as a fraction of forward top speed.

steerFalloff.description: Turn rate shrinks with speed by this fraction at top speed, giving ~30 m radius (SuperTuxKart).

driftMinSpeed.description: Fraction of top speed needed to start a drift.

driftKeepSpeed.description: Drift cancels with no boost below this fraction.

groundStick.description: metres; stay glued to the ground within this height so crests do not launch the kart

wallScrub.description: Fraction of forward speed lost on a hard wall hit.

tSearchWindow.description: Spline fraction searched around the previous t. Never search globally.

driftVisualSlip.description: rad; render-only body yaw offset at full drift

dashMassBonus.description: Added to collision mass while any boost is live. MK8DX has a separate 'dash mass' for exactly this, so a boosting light kart can still win a bump.

coinShield.description: Mario Kart's real coin rule: coins are a hit buffer. With coins in hand a hit costs coins and speed but no full spin-out; at zero coins the same hit spins you.

slowedTo.description: Speed multiplier applied instead of a spin when the kart has at least one coin.

bumpCooldownSeconds.description: Min seconds between kart-vs-kart shoves for a pair

hardWallFraction.description: A wall hit is hard (scrubs speed) when outward speed / total speed exceeds this

slipstreamSameWayDot.description: Min dot of both forward vectors to count as drafting

hopLandWindow.description: Multiple of hopSeconds inside which landing with stick held locks a drift

maxBoostMultiplier.description: Hard ceiling on any boost multiplier (design §7: pad and item are +40%). requestBoost clamps to it.

bumpForce.description: Lateral m/s given to the lighter kart on contact, scaled by weight difference

hitSpinSeconds.description: Default stun when an item or hazard lands

hitCoinsLost.description: Mario Kart World lowered this from 3 to 2 for every racer.

hook.description: Researched 8 Sept 2026 against Mario Kart World. hardBump = heavy: every Mario Kart decides a bump by collision mass, and MKW's own Weight tooltip says weight 'affects collision between vehicles'. light and medium take none. A light 'fastCharge' hook was rejected: MK8DX's hidden Mini-Turbo stat is per character and kart part and does not track weight (Bowser is max, Wario is min). A medium 'keepCoins' hook was rejected as invented and replaced by base.coinShield, which gives every racer the real Mario Kart coin buffer (design §4, 8 Sept 2026).

skins.description: Alt palettes. All racers are available from the start; only skins unlock (design §10).

bodies.description: Shared kart body styles. Cosmetic only: no stat change, so leaderboard times stay comparable.

ai.description: AI driver constants (docs/sops/ai-driver.md Approach). Never set per race; the defaults are the only values. src/ai-driver/constants.ts reads them. Seconds, metres, radians; fractions are of top speed or half-width as named.

lookAheadGain.description: look-ahead L = clamp(speed × gain, min, max) metres (turbo-kart-rush)

turnNearSeconds.description: heading change measured this far ahead in seconds of travel

lateralMaxFraction.description: lateral target clamp as a fraction of halfWidth

edgeMargin.description: metres kept from the road edge

dErrMax.description: rad/s clamp on the derivative term

offroadGain.description: steer gain multiplier while off the road surface

noiseSmoothing.description: low-pass factor per tick on the seeded steering noise

avoidLookAhead.description: metres ahead a slow or stopped kart is treated as a hazard

slowKartSpeed.description: m/s; a kart slower than this ahead is an obstacle

passClosing.description: m/s closing speed that starts a pass

seekLateral.description: max metres off the line a pad, balloon or coin pulls the kart

padSkill.description: min skill to aim for boost pads

hopCommit.description: seconds after the hop the drift side is held no matter what

overRotate.description: rad of error against the drift side that releases

aligned.description: rad; release when the error and turnNear are both this small

edgeMargin.description: metres from the inside edge that releases

tierBySkill.description: skill below [0] → tier 1, below [1] → tier 2, else 3

stuckSeconds.description: the AI's own stuck timer; the race-manager 6 s respawn is the backstop

deadZone.description: metres of gap with no effect

scale.description: metres; tanh scale beyond the dead zone

powerFrom.description: rb below this cuts power (top-speed cap); above it only skill moves

fieldPaceSpread.description: seeded per-race pace governor spread across the AI field, fraction of legal top speed

straightTurn.description: rad; |turnFar| below this is a straight

autopilot.description: a finished kart keeps rolling out of the way

profiles.description: Difficulty comes from the speed class: 50 easy, 100 normal, 150 hard (ai-driver Decisions 2026-09-21).

aiPersonality.description: Per-racer AI flavour (design §4). lateralBias −1..1 as a fraction of laneHalf; aggression and driftUse 0..1 are seeded roll thresholds.

aiProfile.description: skill 0..1 drives line, drift tier and reactions; power ≤ 1 is the top-speed cap as a fraction of the player-legal speed; noise is steer noise amplitude; reaction is seconds before an item is used; startPress is seconds before go the throttle goes down, mean ± spread.
